text: Which of the following resources is specifically known for curated metabolic pathways drawn from the primary experimental literature?
explanation: MetaCyc is the database of curated metabolic pathways compiled from experimental literature. BRENDA instead focuses on enzyme kinetic parameters such as Km, kcat, and inhibitors; BiGG provides standardized reaction and metabolite identifiers linked to genome-scale metabolic models; and Cas-OFFinder is unrelated to metabolic engineering entirely, as it is a CRISPR off-target search tool.
